Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in Mondelez International Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $58.60 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) has declined 6.02% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.57% the S&P500.
